Dear [Miss Harrison](../persons.html#2260)
I believe the letter is from you though it is not the usual signature - I do not know if you mean the original first number of the [Monthly Packet ](../others.html#52)or the first number of the series - I have only one copy of the first, and that it is in a bound volume and marked and I do not like to post it without being sure that it is what you want

yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: With envelope addressed to \'Miss Harrison, St Cross, Weybridge\' and postmarked Weybridge 12 October 1887.
